sections.body: Anaclet's Experts Legal & Financial Consultancy Ltd (AELFC Ltd) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use our contact form, booking form, or reach out via WhatsApp or email, we collect the information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, phone number, profession, and details about the service you are requesting.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information only to respond to your inquiry, schedule and deliver the service you requested, and communicate with you about that engagement. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: How We Store Your Information
sections.body: Form submissions on this site are sent to our email inbox via Formspree. We do not operate a separate database of website visitor submissions.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: As a legal and financial consultancy, we treat all client information with strict confidentiality, consistent with our professional obligations.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, contact us using the details on our contact page.
This policy covers paid coaching and advisory sessions booked through this website.

sections.heading: Booking & Payment
sections.body: Sessions are confirmed once payment has been made and a slot has been agreed with our team. Payment secures your booking time.

sections.heading: Cancellations & Rescheduling
sections.body: If you need to reschedule, contact us at least 24 hours before your scheduled session and we will work with you to find a new time at no extra cost.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Because sessions involve dedicated preparation and reserved time, fees are generally non-refundable once a session has taken place. If you cancel with less than 24 hours' notice or do not attend, the session fee is forfeited. If AELFC Ltd is unable to deliver a session you have paid for, you will receive a full refund or a rescheduled session, at your choice.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: For any question about a specific booking, contact us using the details on our contact page before making payment.
These terms govern your use of this website and any services booked through it with Anaclet's Experts Legal & Financial Consultancy Ltd (AELFC Ltd), based in Kigali, Rwanda.

sections.heading: Use of This Website
sections.body: This website is provided for information about our services and to let clients get in touch, book sessions, and download resources. You agree not to misuse the site, attempt to gain unauthorized access to it, or use its content for unlawful purposes.

sections.heading: Our Services
sections.body: Details on this site about our services, fees and packages are for general guidance. Specific scope, deliverables and terms for any engagement are agreed directly with the client before work begins, and those specific terms take precedence over general descriptions on this site.

sections.heading: No Legal or Financial Advice From the Website Alone
sections.body: Content on this website, including articles, tools and calculators, is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal or financial advice for your specific situation. Formal advice is only given through a direct engagement with AELFC Ltd.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The content, branding and materials on this site belong to AELFC Ltd unless otherwise stated, and may not be reproduced for commercial use without permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: AELFC Ltd is not liable for losses arising from reliance on general website content in place of a direct professional engagement, or from third-party tools (such as WhatsApp or Formspree) used to communicate with us.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time; the current version is always the one published on this page.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be directed to us using the details on our contact page.
